sections.title: Rooms for cricket and honest sports
sections.what: Checks the five sports are listed, the cricket match shows its chart, leverage meter, provisional labels, replay status and story items, that football and F1 say no model or describe events honestly, that basketball and tennis are source pending, and that an unknown match returns not found.
sections.why: Protects both the richness of the cricket room and the honesty of the rooms where data is missing.
sections.watch_out: Named matches and exact messages are fixed, so changing seeded data or wording will break these checks.

summary: Browser tests of the Rooms pages: five sports listed, a cricket match with its win-probability chart and meters, a football and F1 room that say no model exists, and basketball and tennis marked source pending.
purpose: Confirms each sport room shows what it actually has and is honest where data is missing.
why: Rooms are where users follow live or replay matches, so each must show the right data or say why it cannot.
how: The first test lists five sports, opens cricket, and then a specific match. It checks the heading, the chasing chart, a peak leverage meter, two provisional labels, the historical replay status, a recorded date badge, and more than two story items, then runs an accessibility check. The second test opens a football match and checks it says no win-probability model exists and has no meter. It checks the F1 room mentions pit stops and that basketball and tennis are marked as pending. Finally it expects an unknown cricket match to return not found.
inputs: The Rooms pages and their seeded matches.
outputs: Pass or fail for sports list, chart, meters, honesty messages and missing-match handling.
risks: Specific match names and identifiers are fixed, so changes to the seeded data break the tests.
debug: If the cricket page fails, check the chart and the leverage meter values. If the pending messages fail, confirm the sport's source status.
